email.subject: Quick fix for Forge Co Fitness's site
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I checked Forge Co Fitness's website and noticed two things likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call button, so people searching on their phone can't tap to call and probably just call the next gym instead. Also, your hours aren't listed anywhere, which makes people unsure if you're open right now and they move on rather than ask.

Both are quick, flat-fee fixes. Happy to walk you through exactly what I'd change in a free 10-minute call, no pressure either way.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
